findings.blockingFor: claim that all V2 quote profiles support external direct recipient
findings.certainty: production-source branch risk plus actual reviewed to-callback implementations; specialized profile deployment remains unverified
findings.detail: pool-get-amount-out still defers its input transfer to the pair callback while direct-output changes swap.to away from executor. In the reviewed actual V2 implementations the callback goes to to. A receiver without the executor interpreter cannot run that input payment. The enclosing balance guards should fail closed, but the advertised capability can select an unusable path. Generic reverse identity/getAmountOut witnesses do not prove a different callback target for this profile.
findings.minimumFix: Until the deployed specialized profile is proved and supported, return null for direct-output requests on pool-get-amount-out and omit directOutput for that descriptor; keep existing executor receiver, pre-transfer quote timing and deferred/self behavior unchanged. Do not swap to prepayment solely to silence this issue because model quote may depend on pre-transfer balance.
findings.regression: Explicit pool-quote descriptor must not advertise or issue unsupported direct request. A behavioral host/model must route swap callback to actual to and prove external recipient cannot accidentally run executor payment. Keep constant-product external-recipient success and its real delta guards. If enabling later, bind actual ABI/runtime and run scoped same-state behavior.

limits: This is an independent read-only interface/source/history audit, not a new EVM run, current candidate replay, performance test or formal adapter gate.
Public Blockscout runtime hashes were independently computed, but compiler output was not rebuilt; is_fully_verified=false or missing is preserved. Exact fetched bytes and SHA are retained.
Provenance-stripped runtime-family-descriptors.json is a fixture, not fresh identity. Its sourceReady full artifact was not recovered; do not promote fixture hash equality to source-N provenance.
Eight requested families only; no claim about the other38, no expanded strategy/flashLoan/prepayment/native capability.

All outstanding source/proxy-at-N and current new-mode execution gaps are explicit per variant. Unknown is not unsupported and existing old dual evidence is not reused as new recipient/deferred EVM proof.
No production, generated, catalog, IMPL, peer, coffee, git or cloud process state was modified. No credentials, signing, broadcast, live, RPC or project tests/builds were used.
